visualCharacteristics: 720px full-bleed photo with dark overlay, heading and outlined button centered at the bottom (not vertically centered like vanilla hero).
contentPattern: Full-bleed background image with H2 and 'Zum Shop' CTA
usage: Use for a full-width banner at the top of a page where a heading and a single call to action sit over a photo. Row 1: background image. Row 2: heading (H1 or H2) and an optional link.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any photo banner with bottom-anchored centered text. If text must be vertically centered or left-aligned, consider the base hero block instead.
